newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK STOCKS UP 1.28 PCT AT 1300 LOCAL (1000GMT).
newsitem.headline: GREEK STOCKS UP 1.28 PCT AT 1300 LOCAL (1000GMT).

text.p: The Athens bourse's general share index was up 1.28 percent at 1,512.59 from Thursday's 1,493.53 at 1300 local (1000 GMT).
Banks and industrials were trading 1.31 and 1.59 percent higher, respectively.
A technical problem with the Athens stock exchnage feed has interrupted price and trading information. The problem is being worked on. --Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
